title: Juicy Nostalgic Earthy Ferment Stir-fry
description: A uniquely Japanese dish featuring earthy flavors, juicy vegetables, and a touch of chimichurri sauce to bring a tangy umami profile.

ingredients.name: Chilis
ingredients.notes: Thai bird's eye chilies or serrano peppers

instructions: Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Add Kombucha, chopped Chilis, minced Garlic, and finely diced Onion.
Sauté for about 3-5 minutes until onions are translucent and flavors have infused into the liquid.
Add finely chopped fresh herbs (like cilantro or parsley) to the wok as a garnish.
